description: This file contains Go unit tests for setting up server routes in the AgentFieldServer, including metrics, health checks, and agent monitoring functionalities. It uses the gin framework for HTTP routing and includes mock implementations for storage and services.

methods.name: TestSetupRoutesRegistersMetricsAndUI
methods.description: Tests that the server routes are correctly registered for metrics endpoint and root redirect, verifying CORS headers and response codes.

methods.name: TestSetupRoutesRegistersHealthEndpoint
methods.description: Tests the health check endpoint behavior, including response content, status code, and CORS headers, under different configurations.

methods.name: TestUnregisterAgentFromMonitoringResponses
methods.description: Tests the agent unregistration endpoint, verifying behavior with missing node id, unavailable health monitor, and successful unregistration.
